text: The LORD reigns; he is robed in majesty. The LORD is robed, girded with strength. The world stands firm; it cannot be shaken.
Your throne has stood from of old; you are from everlasting.
The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their pounding waves.
Mightier than the thunder of many waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.
Your decrees are wholly trustworthy; holiness adorns your house, O LORD, for endless days.

versions.text: Your decrees stand firm; holiness adorns your house, O LORD, for all the length of days.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew intensifier מְאֹד ("very, exceedingly") is not represented in "stand firm"; the sense is that the testimonies are utterly reliable. Also, "for all the length of days" is a stiff calque of לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים; "for endless days" reads more naturally aloud while keeping the temporal image.
